tasks.goal: Create three markdown files in a workspace — sourdough-starter.md, weeknight-pasta.md, and slow-cooker-chili.md — each with a short recipe and a one-paragraph description of the dish. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, generate an index.md that links to all three files with accurate titles and one-line descriptions summarizing each recipe.

Build a small Node.js HTTP API server (server.js) for a podcast catalog with routes GET /episodes, GET /episodes/:id, POST /episodes, and DELETE /episodes/:id, including request bodies and status codes. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, write a README.md documenting every route exactly as implemented by reading server.js, including request/response shapes and status codes.

Build a single-page web app that displays a static tide chart for a fictional coastal town, letting the user pick a date from a dropdown to see high/low tide times and heights rendered as a simple table and chart.
Build a small command-line expense-splitting app that takes a group of people and a list of shared expenses, then computes who owes whom and how much to settle up evenly.

Build a small HTTP API server for a library loan system with routes to list books, check out a book, return a book, and list overdue loans, including in-memory storage and proper status codes for errors like already-checked-out.
